definition.simple: The smallest building block of everything in the universe. Imagine a Lego brick that makes up everything you see.
definition.academic: The smallest particle of an element that can take part in a chemical reaction and may or may not exist independently.

common_misconceptions: Atoms are visible under a normal microscope. (Correction: They are far too small. Even powerful optical microscopes cannot see them!)
ai_context.tutor_hint: To show how small an atom is, tell the student: 'A drop of water contains about 1.67 x 10^21 atoms!'
